verdict.summary: A share in one cask, a register and a warehouse's holds outline the structure. The reader cannot read Hedera, the warehouse cannot hold the cask for the co-owners as a class, and nothing says whether the platform's register or the Hedera serial prevails, which matters because card buyers' serials sit in Cask Capital's wallet. The warehouse, inspector, valuer and insurer are all unnamed, so only the issuer speaks today.
